articleTitle: Digital Twin-based Software-defined UAV Networks Using Queuing Model
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In order to deploy unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in a variety of scenarios and to ensure the performance, reliability, and safety of these systems, a flexible and adaptable core network infrastructure is required. In this regard, software-defined network (SDN), allows the centralized control and coordination using software rather than traditional hardware-based controllers for the operation of UAVs to provide a flexible and scalable platform. On the other hand, digital twin (DT) technology has the potential which can provide real-time monitoring, analysis, and virtualization of network performance with rapid prototyping and testing to revolutionize the way that software-defined UAV networks are designed, implemented, and maintained. Therefore, in this paper, DT integrated approach for software-defined UAV networks is proposed with a routing flow adjustment algorithm. We also demonstrate its capability through the M/M/1 queueing model. Results have shown that our proposal outperforms typical queueing models without the integration of SDN and DT in terms of efficiency, reliability, and agility of UAV networks and provides visualized network analyzing platform with real-time monitoring feature.

articleTitle: A Deep Analysis of Transfer Learning Based Breast Cancer Detection Using Histopathology Images
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Breast cancer is one of the most common and dangerous cancers in women, while it can also afflict men. Breast cancer treatment and detection are greatly aided by the use of histopathological images since they contain sufficient phenotypic data. A Deep Neural Network (DNN) is commonly employed to improve accuracy and breast cancer detection. In our research, we have analyzed pre-trained deep transfer learning models such as ResNet50, ResNetl01, VGG16, and VGG19 for detecting breast cancer using the 2453 histopathology images dataset. Images in the dataset were separated into two categories: those with invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and those without IDC. After analyzing the transfer learning model, we found that ResNet50 outperformed other models, achieving accuracy rates of 90.2%, Area under Curve (AUC) rates of 90.0%, recall rates of 94.7%, and a marginal loss of 3.5%.

articleTitle: Handwritten OCR for word in Indic Language using Deep Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: A large number of Indian documents are handwritten and India is a diverse nation with many languages. These handwritten documents contain important historical and cultural information which needs to be preserved by converting to digital format. The major problem is everyone has unique handwriting with different styles of writing. To address this problem, we have trained Handwritten Optical Character Recognition (HOCR) in eight Indian languages i.e. Bangla, Gujarati, Gurumukhi, Hindi, Kannada, Odia, Telugu, and Urdu. The datasets IIIT-HW-Dev and IIIT-HW-Telugu refer to a Devanagari dataset and a Telugu dataset respectively. The IIITINDIC-HW-WORDS consists of 872K handwritten words written in 8 Indic scripts by 135 writers. Devanagari and Telugu datasets are comprised of 95K and 120K handwritten words respectively. Tamil and Malayalam languages are excluded due to issues in the IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS dataset. The paper describes how the CNN-Transformer architecture leverages visual and textual features to perform OCR tasks in different languages. The model takes word images as input then CNN generates visual features, and feeds them to the transformer decoder for text generation. An encoder ResNet<inf>18</inf> and a decoder from a transformer have been used for all eight languages to evaluate the performance of this architecture. This architecture performed best in Kannada with just a 1.5% character error rate.

articleTitle: A Robust Object Recognition Using Modified YOLOv5 Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Human beings can recognize and detect the object in any image or video with ease, but when it comes to machines dealing with the same task, it’s quite challenging. In the past years, there has been significant progress in the area of computer vision. However, researchers are still working on enhancing the performance of object recognition algorithms in terms of accuracy and speed. This paper presents one of the greatest CNN representatives, You Only Look Once (YOLO), which tackles object detection in the simplest and most efficient way. This study primarily focuses on object recognition with modified YOLOv5. Here, we have implemented the model on a dataset comprising five objects. We have analyzed various preprocessing and feature extraction techniques to enhance the performance of the proposed model. The highest mean average precision (mAP) achieved by the modified YOLOv5 is 90.7%. The recognition performance of the modified YOLOv5 is compared with the YOLOv4 algorithm. It is also compared with various conventional object detection algorithms outside the YOLO family, such as Support vector machine (SVM), deep Convolutional neural network (CNN), and EfficientNet. The results proved to be promising as compared to the other state-of-the-art techniques.

articleTitle: Multiple Image Watermarking in YCbCr Color Space Using Schur-SVD-DCT in Wavelet Domain and its authentication using SURF
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In this proposed work, YCbCr color space is used for watermarking. Three different watermark logos are used to watermark Y, Cb, and Cr color spaces. The proposed watermarking method uses fundus image, ultrasound DICOM (Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine) image of liver and Lena image as the host images. This work uses the properties of Lifting wavelet transform (LWT), Discrete cosine transform (DCT), Schur decomposition and Singular value decomposition for watermarking. The LWT is used to split the image into different sub-bands (low-low, high-low, low-high, high-high). For watermarking HL, LH, and HH sub-bands are used. The SVD is used to extract the dominant matrix. The proposed scheme is highly robust and imperceptible when compared with other techniques. Speeded up robust features (SURF) are used for feature matching authentication. The presented scheme is resistant to numerous attacks, including Median filter, Salt and Pepper noise, Gaussian noise, Rotation, Average filter, Sharpening, Histogram equalization and Speckle noise. The Structural similarity index measurement (SSIM), Peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR), Normalized correlation coefficient (NCC), and mean square error (MSE) are the metrics that are used to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Temporally Conditioning of Generative Adversarial Networks with LSTM for Music Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Music-generating machine learning models rely on Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) or Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). However, recently Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) have also been used to produce music waveforms. In this work, we fuse the essential aspects of these networks to create a unified framework, like CNN to create bar-wise (a succession of MIDI notes) melodies and GAN to find the underlying distributions of musical melodies and condition them to preserve temporal information. Conditioning is done using RNN over only the generator model of the GAN for exploiting past temporal information. It provides the ability for the model to construct melodies from scratch by either trying to follow a sequence of chords or conditioning the tune of the previous bars (such as a priming tune). Chords of the music act as an accompaniment for the melody. Music often has many instruments/tracks with their temporal flow but unfolds independently. Our model allows for multi-MIDI channel music creation (i.e., tracks), which generates eight bars of continuous music from scratch (i.e., without human inputs). We also propose objective metrics for assessing the quality of music, where the proposed model showed improved performance, including improvements over subjective evaluations like Mean Opinion Score (MOS) as compared to real music. Our complete model code is publicly available.

articleTitle: Whitening Transformation of i-vectors in Closed-Set Speaker Verification of Children
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Automatic speaker recognition may be beneficial for children in a wide variety of disciplines, such as child education, security and safety. However, owing to a variety of issues in children’s speech, including immature vocal tracts, native phonology, long pauses, and hesitations, many speech technology applications have trouble recognizing non-native children. In order to assess how the children’s speech impacts the system, the primary objective of this study is to build a closed-set child speaker verffication system for non-native English speakers in both textdependent and text-independent tasks. This study focuses on a Gaussian probabilistic linear discriminant analysis (GPLDA) model that was trained employing i-vectors and several whitening methods. Cosine similarity scoring (CSS) and GPLDA scoring are used to evaluate the claimed outcomes. Additionally, it has been shown that in closedset speaker verification, the zero-phase component analysis (ZCA) transformation outperformed the other whitening transformations.

articleTitle: Ancient Indian Murals Digital Restoration through Image InPainting
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Murals and paintings are an integral part of the history of any civilization. India has deep roots in ancient history and possesses some of its most valuable assets in ancient murals dating back several hundred years. They feature Hindu mythology, traditions, incidents of bravery and cultural events and thus have a substantial social significance in human society. Unfortunately, some of these assets lose value over time due to environmental factors and human negligence. The ground truth regarding their original colour, textures and painting style references is not currently available, due to which their physical restoration is not possible. Therefore, the only way to restore them is through their digital counterparts and image inpainting techniques. In this paper, a complete end-to-end image restoration framework has been presented to virtually repair the damaged regions of the mural paintings using a selective neural style technique for the transfer of realistic-looking damaged textures, a modified U-Net for detecting the damaged regions in an image and a Partial Convolution network for effective image inpainting. The photographs of Rajasthani paintings scrapped from online sources are used as the dataset. The restored results based on the perceptual quality of completion on ancient Indian murals are promising; thus, they may contribute to the digital restoration of murals.

articleTitle: Water Quality Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Water is the most crucial resource of life and it is necessary for the survival of all living creatures including human beings. The survival of business and agriculture depends on freshwater. An essential step in managing freshwater assets is the evaluation of the quality of the water. Before using water for anything, including drinking, chemical spraying (pesticides, etc.), or animal hydration, it is crucial to assess its purity. The ecosystem and the general public’s health are directly impacted by water quality. Therefore, analyzing and predicting water quality is necessary for both environmental and human protection. Machine learning can be used to analyze and predict the water quality based on the parameters like PH value, turbidity, hardness, conductivity, dissolved solids in water and other parameters. In this work, the water quality is predicted by giving the concentration of various parameters as input to machine learning algorithms and the water is classified as safe or unsafe for the usage of domestic purposes.

articleTitle: Modified Efficient Parallel Distributed Arithmetic based FIR Filter Architecture for ASIC and FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Digital FIR filters can be efficiently implemented using distributed arithmetic (DA). Original DA provides low throughput. Parallel DA is proven to be a promising technique for efficient DA implementation. Block-based parallel DA architecture proposed by Singhal and Mohanty is examined and improved by applying a modified LUT decomposition scheme. Experiments with different levels of LUT decomposition are performed with FIR filters of orders 16 and 32. The proposed architectures are implemented in Basys-3 (Artix-7, XC7A35T-1CPG236C) FPGA board. Several critical performance metrics such as the number of slices, maximum clock frequency, dynamic power consumption, and throughput are estimated for different filter orders for the targeted FPGA Board. The proposed architecture is also implemented for ASIC using a 45 nm NanGate open cell library and area, power, and delay are reported. Comparison with state-of-the-art DA architectures for FPGA implementation provides an average of 64% reduction in area and 22% improvement in throughput.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Spoken Telugu digits using MFCC and LPCC via Hidden Markov Models
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: The problem of speech recognition deals with interpreting the message conveyed in a spoken word or sentence. It has much significance in various automated tasks such as controlling home appliances, mobile applications, robotic operations, etc. As the domain of Internet of Things (IoT) evolves, there is much scope to assist people with special needs in various ways in their day today routines. The main stakeholders for this type of applications include senior citizens, specially-abled people, and illiterates of different age groups. In IoT environment, speechenabled supportive systems has got a great significance with various challenges. The systems that deal with spoken languages with a tiny data sets for a specific problem wm be a challenging task. This paper studies spoken digit recognition problem using Hidden Markov Models with three different features. The paper discusses the methods and obtained results.

articleTitle: A Keyframe Extraction Using HDBSCAN With Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Currently video summarization is an emerging research field. Video summarization which is also termed as Keyframe extraction provides an abstract view of the original video. It aims in finding the important events and objects in a video to give an overview of the original video. This research work focuses on fimding the keyframes of the video through the proposed Keyframe Extraction using Particle Swarm optimization. Two features namely color histogram and histogram of Local Binary Pattern are extracted and clustered using Hierarchical Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise. The parameters of clustering are optimized using Particle Swarm optimization. The experimental results show that the proposed method gives better results when compared to the existing methods.

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Identification of Fault location in Hybrid Microgrid using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Hybrid microgrids are emerging technology that integrates the key characteristics of AC and DC microgrids without requiring significant changes to the distribution network. However, its protection faces a lot of challenges due to the integration of various types of Distributed Generation (DG). Integration of DGs into the power system causes a change in the magnitude and directions of short circuit current. Hence the design of the overcurrent protection in a microgrid becomes more complex. This drawback of the conventional protection method is solved by using intelligent protection schemes. In this work, the artificial neural network (ANN) is used for fault detection, classification, and locating faults in hybrid microgrids which are operated in islanded mode. This paper used MATLAB software for generating the dataset of fault voltages and currents from the test model. The trained ANN models were tested for 11 types of faults and nofault scenarios. Mean Square Error (MSE), regression plots, and receiver operating characteristics (ROC) were used to evaluate the performance of the neural network models. The results are encouraging.

articleTitle: Study of Novel Small-Signal JFET Amplifiers in Sziklai pair Topology
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In this paper, novel circuit designs of small-signal amplifiers with JFETs in Sziklai pair topology under common-source and source-follower modes are demonstrated for the first time. With low transconductance, proposed amplifiers produce highest current gain of 1735.90, moderate voltage gain of 3.99, widest bandwidth of 2.17 GHz, highest power gain of 37.53 dBWatt and lowest THD of 1.4S% and gives better results than previously announced JFETs small-signal amplifier in Darlington pair topology. Simulation results collaborated with theoretical analysis and proper reasoning justify our work. Analysis of the proposed amplifiers suggest their wide applicability in FET based constant current sources, Radio/TV receivers, High-pass filters, Low-pass filters, current amplifiers, voltage buffer amplifiers and impedance matching.

articleTitle: Quality Evaluation of Laparoscopic Videos Using the Interdependency of Luminance and Texture Maps
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: The perceived quality of the video during minimally invasive surgeries greatly impacts the success of these medical procedures. Consequently, there is high demand for varied methods aimed at quality assessment (QA) of laparoscopic videos. In this work, a video quality prediction model is proposed to explore the statistical dependency between the subband coefficients of luminance and texture components of motion blurred laparoscopic videos. For this, the publicly available motion blurred videos from the Laparoscopic Video Quality (LVQ) database is used. The luminance map and gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) texture map are computed for each video frame and decomposed using steerable pyramid decomposition method. The decomposed subband coefficients are modelled using Bivariate Generalised Gaussian Distribution (BGGD) and the distribution depicts sharp peaks and long tails. The BGGD $(\alpha,\beta)$ parameters are estimated for each subband level and they are average pooled to estimate the frame-level values. The videos of the LVQ database is randomly divided into 66:34 training-to-testing ratio to perform supervised non-linear regression using Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) network. In training phase, frame-level BGGD parameters are used as inputs along with expert and non-expert Mean Opinion Score (MOS) values as training labels for each video. In testing phase, the quality score of each test video is predicted. The performance of the proposed model is compared to other 2D image QA (IQA) and video QA (VQA) algorithms. The Pearson’s Linear Correlation Coefficient (PLCC) and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) performance metrics are used to evaluate the prediction efficiency of the model. It is observed that the proposed model performs prediction with a PLCC value of 0.9814 for expert training labels. When non-expert training labels are used a PLCC value of 0.9635 is obtained. The model also demonstrates an RMSE value of 0.3939 when expert MOS training labels are used, and an RMSE value of 0.4639 when non-expert MOS training labels are used. The higher correlation scores and lower RMSE values indicate that the model can be used as a VQA technique for analysis of laparoscopic videos affected by blur distortions due to motion.

articleTitle: Design of High Gain Metasurface Antennas using Hybrid Atomic Orbital Search and Human Mental Search Algorithm for IoT Application
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In this manuscript, high gain metasurface antenna is designed using hybrid Atomic orbital search and human mental search optimization algorithm (Hyb-AOSAHMSOA) for IoT applications. Here, the proposed HybAOSA-HMSOA is used to optimize the antenna parameters like radiation efficiency, bandwidth, gain, and return loss. Therefore, the proposed approach has achieved metasurface antenna with high efficiency, and high gain. The simulation of this methodology is done in MATLAB and the performance metrics are analysed. Thus, the proposed approach has attained 23.4%, 20.7% high gain and17.85%, 11.6% lower return loss than the existing methods like design of MS Antenna using genetic algorithm (MSA-GA), and design of MS Antenna using Random Hm Climbing optimization algorithm (MSA-RHCOA) methods respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of i-PPG signals acquired using smartphones for the calculation of pulse transit time and oxygen saturation
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Image-based photoplethysmography (i-PPG) is one of the blooming research fields which make use of videos of individuals to obtain photoplethysmography (PPG) signals. Vital parameters such as SPO<inf>2</inf> and a correlation to blood pressure (BP) were obtained from i-PPG. Videos are taken from the fingertips of 3 healthy individuals and are analyzed for calculating oxygen saturation and pulse transit time (PTT). To calculate the oxygen saturation (SPO<inf>2</inf>), each video is divided into five-second segments. The values found are compared with those calculated from other segments and with reference values obtained from the standard pulse oximeter. To calculate PTT, each frame of the video is divided into four vertical sections of the equal size. Frome these rectangles, PTT is calculated. The results show that the calculated SPO<inf>2</inf> values have mean absolute error and standard deviation between 0.09 and 1, and± 0.571 respectively. An inverse relationship is observed between the calculated PTT values and reference BP values. The correlation between diastolic BP and PTT is found to be good which makes it a suitable parameter for calculating the same.

articleTitle: Coordinated Design of Damping Controllers using Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: This paper presents stability improvement of power system using coordinated design of damping controllers. The main objective of this work is to minimize the rotor speed deviation of the machine. A Single machine infinite bus (SMIB) is considered for analysis. The system performance has been analyzed under different operating conditions. The parameters of damping controllers are obtained using Grey Wolf optimization (GWO) algorithm. The responses obtained using GWO is compared with other three competitive methods to show the efficacy of the suggested approach. It was found that GWO method is capable to suppress power system oscmations effectively.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation Of a High Throughput Low Power Advanced Encryption Standard (AES-128) Cipher
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Ensuring secure transmission and storage of digital information is critical for any organization to function properly. To address this issue, encryption algorithms are commonly used. Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) has been globally adopted as the mainstay cipher algorithm for securing transmission networks and storage devices due to its easy implementation and compatibility with both hardware and software applications. Another reason for its widespread popularity is its uncompromisable nature against existing brute force attacks, making it practically unbreakable on existing computing power. AES implementation for battery operated devices requires an algorithm with low power consumption and high-speed encryption/decryption of digital data. This paper proposes an FPGA implementation of a high throughput parallel pipelined 128-bit AES algorithm with a low power key expansion mechanism for iterative stages. A 128-bit symmetric key has been used for undertaking 10 rounds of transformations. All the encryption and decryption transformations are simulated using iterative design methodology in order to minimize hardware consumption. Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA device is used for hardware evaluation and Verilog HDL for programming. Simulation and synthesis task has been performed on Xilinx Vivado v2021.1 IDE. The results exhibit high-rate encryption of 68 Gb/s and low energy consumption of 7 pJ/bit.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation and Real-Time Simulation of Unit-Template Technique Controlled DSTATCOM for Power Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Electrical and Electronic consumers create harmonic burdening of the Power Network Infrastructure. On the distribution side non-linear loads like classical rectifiers draw non-sinusoidal currents which demand reactive power, inject harmonics in the entire power system, and create impact on the Power Quality. Gird waveforms get polluted due to these non-linear loads and result in severe distortions on other connected devices. Interfacing of distributed energy reserves connected with the distribution power grid can again step in provocation of harmonic power losses. Old compensation practices are no longer acceptable, and it is important to develop an equipment to furnish local reactive and harmonic compensation. In this paper, performance investigation on Distribution Static Compensator (DSTATCOM) is proposed for mitigation of harmonics, reactive power compensation and Power Quality improvement in a three-phase three-wire (3P-3W) power system. DSTATCOM is operated by the Unit Template Technique. Simulation model is designed in MATLAB and then real time test cycle is performed using RT-LAB software. In the RT-LAB, Master and Console Blocks are designed for computation and communication with the Opal-RT (4510) which is used for building of the model and Real Time Results are displayed on the Hardware synchronized oscilloscope (MSO5204) device from RIGOL Company.

articleTitle: Application of Deep CNN for image-based identification and classification of plant diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Plant leaf disease detection has a significant contribution in preventing impeded growth of plants which results in low-and poor-quality yield. Agriculture has a significant role in Indian economy as well as for many other countries. Hence, it is required to prevent quantity reduction and quality degradation which are a result of plant diseases. In the past, farmers identified and monitored plant ailments with naked eyes. It required significant expertise for identification of disease-and disease-causing agent. In recent years with advanced technology, using automated techniques of smart farming, plant disease identification and diagnosis can be easily done. It is very beneficial in case of big farms where lot of monitoring work is significantly reduced. Also, the disease can be identified at a very early stage when first symptoms appear on leaves. This paper explores the potential of deep learning for detection of plant disease. This method involves use of image processing with deep learning so as to obtain a clear image or useful information. Further, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with input layer, output layer, and hidden layers is used for image classification.

articleTitle: Kannada Word Detection in Heterogeneous Scene Images
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Text extraction from scene images has started gaining a lot of traction in recent years in the computer vision field as its applications is manifold. One of its sub-categories is scene text detection. Factors like complex backgrounds, curvature, orientation, image quality, and various font styles and sizes makes it a difficult task. Moreover, building a single language scene text detector in a multilingual setting, especially Indian scripts, is more challenging in contrast to a general text detector. In this Work We attempt the task of Kannada text localization as Well as Word detection in natural scenes, Which is underexplored in comparison to other Well-known Indian languages. To achieve this, We fine tune a You Only Look Once (YOLOv4) based object detection model on our Kannada scene text images dataset collected. Experiments on local boards and sign images captured on smartphone, showed a mean average precision of 93.5% and per image average detection speed of 30 milli-seconds; pointing towards real time use and integration With mobile applications.

articleTitle: DoS Attack Detection in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) Using Hybrid Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are utilized in a variety of applications where distant data gathering is required, such as environmental monitoring, military applications, traffic control and health monitoring among others. They are made up of numerous inexpensive, compact sensor nodes, which collaborate to gather data and transmit it to the Base Station (BS) for analysis.WSNs use radio frequencies to communicate and due to this, WSNs are vulnerable to various attacks, including Denial of Service (DoS) attacks. A Denial-of-Service attack is any operation that disables the network from carrying out the planned tasks and transmits unnecessary packets while attempting to use network bandwidth. The network user is unable to access the services when they are demanded. Algorithms like Support Vector Machine, k-Nearest Neighbour, Naïve Bayes, and Random Forest are used to construct a Hybrid Machine Learning model. This approach will be used to identify potential targets for such attacks before they occur.

articleTitle: A Better Approach for Students Employability Indexing using Machine Learning.
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Students’ employability is a major issue for colleges and universities, and a technique for detecting student employability sooner is always important to take fast action. However, the work market environment is more dynamic than ever because of globalisation, computerization, and recent advancements in artificial intelligence. Many approaches for forecasting unemployment rates based on search engine query data have recently been developed. To help comprehend how graduates are hired 2 better machine learning approaches have been used: XGBoost, Decision Tree. The performance parameters on which these algorithms were accessed are: Precison, Recall, FI Score and Accuracy. After performing parameter tuning on old approach XGBoost achieved accuracy of 82 percent and Decision Tree achieved 80 percent. This study is quite promising, which has pushed the researchers to improve the procedure and evaluate the developed prediction model for Fig further study.

articleTitle: Energy Aware Cluster Head Rotation for D2D Multicasting
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Low energy consumption is a significant performance metric for battery operated device which is specially suitable to operate in a disaster prone areas. Device to Device (D2D) multicasting is expected to be energy efficient for providing suitable communications to a group of users served by a common device known as cluster head (CH). However, due to multiple influencing parameters the consumed energy of the CH becomes higher in comparison to the cluster members. To handle this issue, we have proposed a suitable CH rotation algorithm for implementing the energy efficient D2D multicasting. The objective of the proposed approach is to provide energy efficient cluster based D2D communications to a suitable number of selected target users such that the consumed energy of the operating CH does not exceed the battery capacity of the device. This is implemented through a suitable CH rotation technique that operate in duty cycle mode to serve a common set of cluster members. We validate our approach through extensive simulations in network simulator 2 (NS2) and through a comparative study with the existing approach.

articleTitle: Aerial IRS-assisted Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) has emerged as a promising technology that open-up the window for manipulating the wireless channel. This introduced an additional degree of freedom in designing the future wireless communication system. The performance of a simple aerial IRS (AIRS) assisted wireless communication system is investigated in this paper by jointly optimizing the active and passive beamforming to maximize the sum-rate (SR). An alternating iterative algorithm is exploited to convert the non-convex optimization problem into two suboptimal problems corresponding to the active and passive beamforming. The simulated results highlight the possible SR gain that one can achieve through optimization in comparison to the un-optimized scenario. It also demonstrates the fact that optimization of beamforming also enhances the power efficiency of the system and also the impact of the IRS structure.

articleTitle: A vision-based litter detection and classification using SSD MobileNetv2
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Municipal solid litter generation has steadily increased significantly in recent years. To prevent waste from collecting in the environment, it is beneficial to clean up wastes and rubbish using autonomous cleaning equipment such as unmanned surface vehicles. Cleaning efficiency requires a high-accuracy and reliable object detection system. Many machine learning techniques are explored so far to produce litter recognition systems. There are few studies on the effectiveness of cuttingedge deep learning object detection algorithms in the domain of litter localization and detection. We propose a detection and classification module for five different waste objects in this research. The dataset is created by gathering photos from various sources and under various environmental conditions at our Institute. In order to enhance the quantity of data, data augmentation techniques are used. Image processing and feature extraction steps are applied to enhance the performance of the proposed model. The SSD MobileNetv2 model is employed for litter recognition which detects and identifies distinct contaminants and hazardous waste materials with a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 0.84. The proposed module aids in environmental cleanup by efficiently detecting the waste objects present in the surrounding environment.

articleTitle: Color Attenuation Prior Based Single Image Dehazing
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In today’s technologies, digital images of the real world play a crucial role. Any mode of transportation can employ digital imagery to control traffic. Clearly stated Images are essential for traffic monitoring, but our environment is full of dust particles, fog, and other disturbances depending on the weather. Haze is the aggregate name for these disturbances that scatter ambient light and subsequently affect the clarity of the images that are taken. The images that we take often have haze, thus we refer to them as hazy images.The collected images must have the haze removed in order to be monitored. Dehazing, often known as the process of removing haze, can be carried out in a variety of methods. In this research, we employ the Haze lines Prior method of estimating atmospheric light along with the Color Attenuation Prior method for dehazing. The databases O-haze, I-haze,FRIDA and some hazy real world images without ground truth images are used to validate the proposed method. By analyzing PSNR and SSIM values on a pair of ground truth and hazy images, the algorithm’s effectiveness is evaluated.The performance metrics of the suggested algorithm produced outcomes that were superior to those of the existing methods.

articleTitle: Development of an modified Ant Colony Optimization algorithm for solving path planning problems of a robot system
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In the modern world of high-speed technologies, where every operation needs to be performed instantaneously and more efficiently, scientists and engineers have created a Bioinspired algorithm to solve the problems encountered in realworld activities. The Ant Colony optimisation (ACO) algorithm is one such solution that assists in solving the problems of robot path planning. In this work-in-progress article, we propose a new way of using the ACO algorithm which ensures solving the problems encountered in traditional ACO algorithms. This algorithm was tested on two environments to examine output efficiency and computational output time. The results show that the proposed ACO algorithm is completely efficient in small-scale environments and remarkably better results were observed on testing it in the bigger-scale environment. The evaluations prove that the ACO algorithm for path planning can provide rapid path planning with acceptable results and for future development can be integrated with the robot system to test it in any real-world scenarios by increasing the number of ants.

articleTitle: Design Analysis of 3-Bit Flash ADC using Low-Offset and Low-Power Opamp
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: This paper presents a unique 3-bit Flash Analog to Digital Converter (ADC) required in signal processing applications designed with the help of two stage operational amplifier as comparator designed on 90nm technology on Cadence Virtuoso and priority encoder designed using ratioed logic. This flash ADC can operate at low supply voltage of 1.2V. The other advantage of this ADC is in terms of ratioed priority encoder which results in the reduction of number of transistors. The comparator is simulated with 1.2V supply voltage at 27°C. The significant merit of the designed comparator is its low offset voltage of 1.9328mV, overall power dissipation of 22.49uW and bandwidth of 2.39KHz on 90nm technology. The comparator has been designed on both 90nm and 180nm technology and compared. For power dissipation of comparator designed on 90nm technology, Monte Carlo simulation is done with 200 samples and process variation is done at different corners. Flash ADC is simulated on 1.2V supply voltage using 90nm technology with power dissipation of 662iiW.

articleTitle: Image and Video D’encryption using Gray Pattern based algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In the present era of communication, huge amount of multimedia data is being transmitted and received. Security and privacy of the data are important issues that must be addressed. Therefore, there is need of encryption to prevent breach of multimedia data. In this paper we bring out a new encryption algorithm, efficient for image as well as video. The algorithm mainly focuses on the confusion amongst the image pixels with the shuffle key generated by the gray pattern. Key generated by the gray pattern is observed to be more resistant than other random generated keys. The reason lies in the efficiency of gray pattern to create several pixel permutations. Our algorithm has achieved ideal results for gray scale, color, DICOM, thermal and UV images. The algorithm can be efficiently applied for video encryption. The performance of the proposed algorithm is compared with the existing algorithms by checking the metrics like Histogram, Entropy, Key sensitivity, Number of Pixel Change Rate, Unified Average Change in Intensity and Peak Signal to Noise Ratio. The algorithm has shown good security levels and outperformed existing algorithms. A Graphical User Interface has been designed to showcase all the results and metric which is an added advantage for better analysis of algorithm.

articleTitle: Multilevel Thresholding of Grayscale Complex Crop Images using Minimum Cross Entropy
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Crop image segmentation plays a key step in the field of agriculture. The crop images present near the environs have complex backgrounds and their grayscale histogram is mostly multimodal. Hence, multilevel segmentation of grayscale crop images may be helpful for better analysis. This paper proposed multilevel thresholding of grayscale crop images incorporated with minimum cross entropy as an objective function. The time complexity of this technique increases with the threshold levels. Hence, the coronavirus herd immunity optimizer (CHIO) has been amalgamated with the objective function. This technique improves the image’s accuracy. The CHIO is a humanbased algorithm that separates the foreground and background efficiently with multiple thresholds value. The simulation has been performed on grayscale crop images. It is. compared with bacterial foraging algorithm (BFO), and beta differential algorithm (BDE) to validate the accuracy. The results validates that the proposed method outperforms BFO and BDE for grayscale crop images in terms of fidelity parameters. The qualitative and quantitative results evidence the proficiency of suggested method.

articleTitle: Handwritten Devanagari Word Detection and Localization using Morphological Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In text analysis systems, text detection and localization techniques are preliminary steps for further text recognition tasks. Finding the specific text information in the image is important as it has many significant real-time applications. The available techniques for text detection and localization work well for printed text, but their performance is not good for handwritten text present in an image. Also, the available modern deep learning techniques require large datasets for training. S0, if small handwritten data images are available, then image processing and an effective morphologybased technique for text detection and localization can be used. In this paper, these techniques are used for handwritten documents written in the Devanagari script.

articleTitle: Cross-terms Reduction in WVD using Sliding Window-based Variational Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Wigner-Ville distribution (WVD) has become one of the powerful tools in the time-frequency analysis of non-stationary signals. Still, the presence of cross-terms in WVD for multi-component signals limits its applicability and interpretation. Variational mode decomposition (VMD) has been applied to remove the cross-terms from WVD. However, it fails to remove cross-terms between the spectral components from the same frequency band but with different time signatures. This paper proposes a novel sliding window-based VMD (SW-VMD) technique for removing cross-terms from WVD by overcoming the drawbacks of the VMD-based WVD method. The proposed method segments a multi-component signal using overlapping windows and each windowed signal is decomposed into intrinsic mode functions using VMD. The WVDs of all the IMFs are added together to obtain the cross-terms free WVD. Energy scaling is also performed to minimize the effect of overlapping windows. The performance of the proposed method is assessed for different multi-component synthetic signals and real-world ECG signals using different performance measures. The simulation results reveal that the SW-VMD-based WVD method can effectively remove the cross-terms from the WVD with a better autoterms information and time-frequency resolution. Results from the proposed method are also compared with the VMD-based WVD method to exhibit supremacy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning Algorithms in Medical Image Analysis: A case study for Breast Cancer detection
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Image processing is a very vital part of many medical diagnosis. With the advent of more technologically advanced devices, machine learning implementation has also proven to be boon in the medical world for imaging related diagnosis. This paper aims to utilize different machine learning models to highlight its efficacy in the field of medical image analysis. The paper uses machine learning classifiers to classify breast cancer into malignant and benign using 31 attributes of the Wisconsin Breast Cancer Diagnostic dataset. Five different classifier models – Decision Trees, SVM, Naive Bayes, KNN and ANN were used to classify the tumors and it was observed and concluded that SVM model performed better with an accuracy of approximately 97.4% followed by ANN model with an accuracy of approximately 96.5%.

articleTitle: Tender Coconut Classification using Decision Tree and Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: A number of industry sectors such as Food & nutraceuticals, Pharma, Irrigation, Transport and Automobile use coconut and its parts for varied products. As different sectors make use of different type and parts of coconut, an automated separation of coconut Would aid in faster processing. Thus the major issue faced by these sectors is the automated sorting of coconut into different categories such as Non-Tender Coconut, Tender Whole coconut, Tender coconut cut With flesh and Without flesh. In this Work We have trained and tested a Decision Tree and DenseNet model to automatically classify coconut images into various categories. For Decision Tree 93% of accuracy Was obtained While the advanced Deep learning model, DenseNet, gave 100% accuracy. This showed that the Deep Learning models such as DenseNet perform better as compared to conventional machine learning algorithms such as Decision Tree.

articleTitle: Smart Cane For Blind People
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)

authors.preferredName: S V S S S S S Saketh Lolabhattu
authors.firstName: S V S S S S S Saketh

abstract: A blind person finds it challenging to recognize obstacles in their path as they move from one spot to another. Moreover, if a stick is lost it is quite difficult to find it in the same spot. As a result, the smart cane is suggested as a treatment to help the blind go about their daily lives without the aid of others. Firstly, ultrasonic sensor detects obstacle then camera module starts detecting that object and gives the name of the obstacle through voice commands. Through voice commands or a microphone will help the blind person get where they are going. Camera module can also detect the faces of family members, relatives through voice commands gives the name of the person. The suggested method uses the Raspberry Pi as the controller. Every obstacle in front of the user can be detected. Maps are used in this smart cane to provide directions from the present position to the destination. If any accident happens it can detect by using accelerometer sensor and send a message and location to family members through telegram bot using internet of things. The smart cane is lightweight, user-friendly, responsive, consumes very little power, and is simple to grasp and fold.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Fuel Economy of Hybrid Electric Vehicle for Different Road and Traffic Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In this paper, hybrid electric vehicle model is tested with different standard driving cycles and respective fuel economy calculations are performed. Afterwards, real life driving cycles are formed and analyzed for different roadways like urban, state highway and expressway. Traffic conditions are also noted and a classification is established for different roadways. The hybrid electric vehicle model is tested again with the real-life driving cycles and respective fuel economy parameters are evaluated. A comparison is made between the outputs obtained from the model with standard and real-life driving cycles as input at different instant of time. The entire work is performed using MATLAB/Simulink software.

articleTitle: Significance of Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) in Deeplabv3+ for Water Body Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Water body segmentation is a difficult task because of complex shapes, edges, sizes, and the surroundings. DeeplabV3+ has proven to perform well on segmentation tasks with multi-scale features. Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) module present in Deeplab models helps to increase the field of view for extracting multi-scale features. In this work, we analyze how the ASPP extracts multi-scale features in DeeplabV3+ by comparing the performance of Deeplabv3+ model with ASPP and without ASPP for water segmentation task. The dataset used for this study is a public dataset that contains RGB satellite images and corresponding masks from sentine1-2 A/B satellite. The evaluation metrics used for this study are IoU score, Dice score, Recall and Precision. The results obtained from the study shows that DeeplabV3+ model with ASPP extract the water bodies with different sizes. It also captures the boundaries accurately compared to the model without ASPP module.

articleTitle: Underwater Image Restoration Using Color Correction and Empirical Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Underwater imaging plays a significant role in discovering assets in the ocean. Underwater images are not visible due to the presence of noise and artifacts in the sea. The author proposed a technique to resolve this problem. In this article, the degraded underwater image applies to empirical mode decomposition after color correction to enhance the image. The suggested approach is compared to the existing state-of-the-art method. The picture has been taken from the UIEB data set for qualitative and quantitative analysis. Compared to traditional procedures, the suggested method produces superior enhanced images with improved visual quality.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Water Body Segmentation by DeeplabV3+Using Two Dimensional Variational Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Monitoring changes in surface water bodies and other earth surface features uses remote sensing data. The DeeplabV3+ network is an encoder decoder based deep neural network that is widely used to segment images with good precision. To improve the predictions made by the DeeplabV3+ model, a novel technique based on the two-dimensional variational mode decomposition (2D-VMD) is proposed in the present work. Sentinel 2A/B images dataset from Kaggle is used for this study. The images and their corresponding annotations are also available. The masks were obtained using the index known as Normalized Water Difference Index (NDWI). From 2841 images, we cropped 100 x100 subsets resulting in 1,50,204 images. The proposed method is found to be effective in improving the predictions made by DeeplabV3+ model. With respect to the images considered for the study, the average F1 score increased from 0.33 to 0.47. The average Jaccard score increased from 0.21 to 0.34.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Enabled Framework for Automatic Brain Stroke Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)

authors.preferredName: D v v v Ch. Mouli

abstract: Brain stroke is causing severe damage to health besides causingdeaths across the globe. Healthcare industry has got technological innovations to improve quality of service. With the emergence of Artificial Intelligence (AI) medical image analysis has unprecedented possibilities. Deep learning approaches have gained popularity for analysing medical images for automatic diagnosis. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based deep learning models such as VGG16, ResNet50 and DenseNet121 are found to be suitable for image processing. However, as one size does not fit all, there is need for optimizing these models in order to adapt them for brain stroke detection and leverage their performance. Towards this end, in this paper, we proposed an AI enabled framework with optimizations to the aforementioned deep models. Towards this end we proposed an algorithm known as Intelligent Learning for Stroke Detection (ILSD). The optimized models are found to have increased prediction performance. Enhanced DenseNet121 showed highest accuracy with 99.82%.

articleTitle: CNTFET Based M-DMTGDI (CMDMTGDI) Design and Its Leakage Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: This work presents CNTFET based Modified DMTGDI design and CNTFET based DMTGDI design, referred to as CMDMTGDI design and CDMTGDI design respectively. The proposed CMDMTGDI overcomes the contention issue in CDMTGDI design. Further leakage reduction techniques-LECTOR, GALEOR and LCNT are proposed for CMDMTGDI design. 2-input type A NAND, NOR and XOR gates are used for simulative investigation using HSPICE tool with 32nm CNTFET Stanford model at 0. 9V and 5fF load capacitance in static and dynamic mode. A maximum PDP reduction of 97.65% and 97.85% is achieved using CDMTGDI and CMDMTGDI as opposed to their CMOS counterparts. The proposed CMDMTGDI design achieves a maximum PDP reduction of 96.62% as compared to its C-DMTGDI counterparts. Further a maximum leakage power saving of 46.52%, 46.68% and 46.5% is achieved using LECTOR, GALEOR and LCNT respectively as compared to its CMDMTGDI counterparts in static mode. Corresponding values are (40.65%, 40.94%, 40.75%) in dynamic mode.

articleTitle: Tunable LSPR in Asymmetric Plasmonic Bowtie Nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Asymmetrical plasmonic bowtie nanostructures on a silica substrate are presented in this paper. The electromagnetic enhancement achieved at the centric vicinity of the asymmetric nano-bowtie is numerically modelled using the Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD). The effects of the degree of asymmetry in terms of the flared angle and the length of the nano-bowtie, the effect of the angle of incident light, and the effect of periodic and aperiodic configurations of these nanostructures are extensively analysed to study the tunability of the localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) wavelength over the visible and near infrared wavelength ranges. These nanostructures can be employed for numerous plasmonic applications like biomedical sensing, fluorescence microscopy, and surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS).

articleTitle: Iron ore image classification using deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: This study presents a method for classifying microscopic images of iron ore using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The dataset used in the experiment consisted of microscopic images of iron ore samples gathered from Kiriburu Iron Ore Mines, Jharkhand, India. Iron ore samples with varying hematite content labelled as hard laminated, soft laminated and lateritic were selected for the study. The CNN model with 3 hidden layers gives test accuracy of 92.16% on the test set. MobileNet-v2 which is pre-trained model yields test accuracy of 98.03%. The results show that CNNs can be effectively used for classifying microscopic images of iron ore and can potentially be applied in the mining industry for quality control and mineral identification.

articleTitle: A Low- Power Low-Noise Current-Feedback Instrumentation Amplifier based on gm boosted OTA for ECG Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: This paper presents a CMOS operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) based current-feedback instrumentation amplifier (CFIA) optimized for low-power and low-noise electrocardiogram (ECG) detection that is implemented as a fully differential difference amplifier (FDDA). The suggested CFIA consists of only a few MOS transistors and an R-C feedback loop. Simulation results in Cadence Virtuoso with SCL $0.18 \mu \mathrm{m}$ CMOS technology are used to assess the effectiveness of the proposed CFIA. The gain, common mode rejection ratio (CMRR), and $-3 \mathrm{~dB}$ bandwidth of the suggested CFIA were found to be $50.25 \mathrm{~dB}$, 99.15 dB, and $0.52 \mathrm{~Hz}-2.62 \mathrm{kHz}$, respectively. PVT analysis is also performed to see the effect on the proposed design’s performance parameters. It achieves input impedance that is high enough across the whole frequency range of an ECG. An input impedance of $796.7 \mathrm{M} \Omega$ at $50 \mathrm{~Hz}$ and input-referred noise (IRN) of $0.016 \mu V_{\text {rms}}$ over 0.1 to $300 \mathrm{~Hz}$ are measured. Power consumption for the proposed CFIA is 189 nW with a 1.8 V power supply. The robustness of the amplifier is verified by the Monte-Carlo mismatch simulation.

articleTitle: Real-time deployment and test set analysis of automatic colonoscopy polyp identification architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Manual detection of polyps in the colonoscopy videos can be challenging due to the large no. of sequential frames, and high chances of false positive rate. So, researchers are working to develop an automatic computer-aided decision system to successfully identify polyps in real-time. The present work proposes a real-time deployment of automatic polyp identification based VGG-16 architecture using flutter application (app) called the Automatic Colonoscopy Polyp Identification (ACPI) testing app. A test set analysis of three open source datasets namely CVC Clinic, CVC Colon, CVC 300 and one private dataset has been done to check the efficacy of the proposed app using various evaluation metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall and F1 score. The proposed app has achieved an average recall, and F1 score up-to 0.7956 and 0.7219 on the developed private dataset consisting of varied colonoscopy polyp and non-polyp frames. The proposed app is immune to inter and intra-device variation and has a user friendly interface. It has achieved encouraging results in comparison to the existing polyp detector app available on Google store, further making it suitable for real-time deployment in this research field.

articleTitle: Automated Static Malware Analysis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Malware analysis has always been one of the crucial and tedious tasks in the field of cyber security to prevent any abnormality in cyberspace. In the world of the internet with an increase in the number of internet users every day, data is being transferred from place to place in the form of tiles or packets, and malware has also transformed into a lot of categories. Researchers have come up with various techniques to deal with malware and a lot of tools have been developed for the task. Through this paper, we wm go through a fundamental study of malware analysis and discuss developing an automated static malware analysis tool using machine learning. A tool to detect and analyse different types of malware using efficient machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Performance of Load Frequency Control of Two-Area Power System by Using Proportional Integral Derivative Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: For connected power system to be legitimate and reliable during active power Transmission. The Performance of Automatic Generation Control is essential and the main objective of this load frequency control is to make the frequency constant and also to maintain the power flow of tie line in each and every area during operational process. In this paper two area system is used and PI and PID controllers are applied in the MATLAB/SIMULINK systems. In this paper we have shown the detailed parameters comparison between the twocontroller using PID tuned method which shows the different stages at which controller makes the system stable for smooth and efficient operation can be improved further or verified whether it is correct or need some changes for different applications.

articleTitle: Designing and Performance Analysis of Low Insertion Loss with Polarization-Insensitive FSS-antenna-radome system for Airbome Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In this paper, an X-band frequency selective surface (FSS)-antenna-radome system has been studied for airborne applications. In order to examine the electromagnetic (EM) behavior after traversing the system, a dipole unit cell FSS and A-sandwich radome wall are developed and simulated in the first step. The -10dB relative bandwidth (BW) of the suggested single element is from 9.6 - 10.7 GHz and with a very good insertion loss (IL) of 0.1 dB. Moreover, the single element Asandwich radome wall structure has a dual band with better IL of 0.1dB and 0. 05dB from the two bands respectively. Both the suggested FSS and radome wall is analyzed for polarization-insensitivity. In the second step, we take a high directional horn antenna, which is then covered with 5 × 6 FSS array on the broadside for secure communication. Then, we design a full radome having same thickness as the unit cell radome wall. The radome is placed on the broadside covering the entire horn antenna and check the EM characteristic at X-band after passing the suggested system. We witness that $S_{11}\leq-10dB$ covering entire X-band with a high gain for the respective structures, making it applicable for airborne radome.

articleTitle: Multi Spectral Feature Extraction to Improve Lung Sound Classification using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: The principal method for screening and diagnosing lung disorders is auscultation of respiratory sounds. In the medical field, automated auscultation is a new research field that helps with faster disease diagnosis. The task of automated auscultation is to classify the respiratory sound, which requires a dataset to build a classification model. Deep learning networks are a popular method for producing such classification models, which require a large number of samples to train. Unfortunately, even the largest publicly accessible respiratory sound dataset (ICBHI 2017) of 5.5 hours total length contains only 6898 respiratory cycles, which is still insufficient for training deep learning networks. In this research work, data augmentation and smart padding techniques are utilised to account for the ICBHI dataset’s class imbalance. Further, we have suggested to extract several features from the audio signal, such as MFCC, Chroma STFT, Mel-Spectrogram, Spectral Contrast, and Tonnetz, for better representation of the samples in a class. Further, we have obtained the statistical features such as mean and standard deviation for developing the classification model. We have utilised a deep learning-based CNN architecture for the classification of the learned features. The proposed method achieved a score of 74.08% for a 60-40 train-test split and 75.04% for an 80-20 train-test split, outperforming all state-of-the-art lung sound classification methods.

articleTitle: Sensor-based Ambient Healthcare Architecture using Blockchain and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Increasing needs of the human race in the healthcare sector demands extensive use of technology and innovations. Healthcare is one dynamic area which grabs the technology for providing optimal and patient-centric treatments. Emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and Blockchain provides broad spectrum of applications that caters the needs of healthcare. Ambience in healthcare can potentially enhances the monitoring procedures and reduces errors related to the clinical procedures. This paper proposes a novel healthcare architecture that incorporates ambient intelligence in the healthcare platform. Blockchain is used as the backbone for the system to provide secured data storage and exchange between different stakeholders in the network. A hardware prototype based on Raspberry Pi Model 4B is developed to which sensors to capture body vital parameters are interfaced. A high-end computing system is used to host the machine learning algorithms which can detect abnormalities in the critical data received from the patient body and the same is reported to the concerned clinicians. This system also performs blockchain mining. The developed system found to be superior in terms of reliability and delay when compared to the existing models. Finally, to better understand the performance of various popular algorithms, a comparative analysis is performed in terms of mean average error (MAE), mean square error (MSE) and root mean square error (RMS). The system is viable and can provide seamless integrated of any existing models.

articleTitle: ANFIS Based-Kinematic Modeling of 2R Robotic Arm
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Robotics have become very useful and meaningful in industrial automation, so their designing and controlling are much considered factor. Robots, as a complicated system, must detect and able to solve the required problem with great perfection and accuracy. To be able to solve the required task robot must have to work with good certainty and it must be flawless in nature. This Analysis shows the robot arm trajectory planning which wm be solved by using Forward and Inverse Kinematics Principles with using ANFIS networks. Providing solution to the IK problem is very useful step as it will decide the location of the gripper where the required task wm be performed. To solve FK and IK problem MATLAB was used and the result are compared of both analytical approach and with ANFIS approach. Adaptive Network based fuzzy inference system (ANFIS), which is a mix of both NN and Fuzzy logic ANFIS was used to the train the data provided by the FK problem, to give more certainty and fidelity to the requiredjoint angles mapping for the 2 degree of freedom robotic arm.

articleTitle: Designing an Efficient Object Detection Model for Autonomous Driving Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: The detection of road objects plays an essential role in the development of autonomous vehicles in intelligent transportation systems, which has become an emerging field in deep learning. Several objects on the road, like vehicles, pedestrians, etc., are necessary to be accurately identified, which guarantees the safety of other people and vehicles in the surroundings. In this article, we aim to design an efficient object detection model for autonomous driving systems. To achieve this, we investigate the recently developed YOLOv7 and optimize the same for improving the detection performance to satisfy the realtime safety requirements of autonomous vehicles. We perform extensive experimentation and demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on the BDDIOOK dataset. Experimental results show that our proposed method increases the detection accuracy to 82.6% and inference speed to 97.2 FPS compared to the baselines, with no additional increase in model complexity.

articleTitle: A novel locally connected recurrent neural network for identification of nonlinear dynamical system
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In this work, a novel Locally Connected Recurrent Neural Network structure (LLCRNN) is designed for the identification of nonlinear systems. The structure is an extension of a local recurrent neural Network with better dynamic extraction capability. The weights are updated using the offline mode of the gradient descent algorithm. The proposed structure is found to give better identification as compared to other considered neural Network structures such as Feed Forward Neural Network (FFNN) and Local Recurrent Neural Network structure (LRNN). The efficiency of the proposed structure is proved against the selected structures.

articleTitle: Optical Character Recognition for Handwritten Telugu Text
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is a process of digitalization of scanned documents. OCR for Telugu language is challenging due to intricacy of characters with almost similar structure. As Telugu has spaces between the characters in a word, character level training decreases the complexity in training dataset and enhances the character recognition rates. The major confronts for developing Telugu OCR especially for handwritten text is character level segmentation which depends of a person’s handwritten style. To deal with Unicode training problem that arises for most of Indic scripts, we have converted label to a string during training and after recognition they are inverse mapped. For feature extraction we have used ResNet-50, which captures the small variances in the character there by increasing the recognition rates. The character level recognition rates of 93.5% are achieved and word level recognition rates of 84% are achieved.

articleTitle: Study of thermocouple degradation through accelerated aging under corrosive environment
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In sodium cooled fast reactors, thermocouples (TC) play an important role for measuring the temperature. Understanding the anomalous behavior of these sensors, especially the process of degradation as they are subjected to high temperature or corrosive liquids is important in ensuring its long term reliability. In this paper, life estimation of thermocouples, undergoing accelerated aging through induced metauurgical sheath fracture is presented. The results for the parametric degradation of the thermocouples are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective based Generation Fuel Cost and Emission Reduction using Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: In this paper, the problems of fuel cost and emission reduction based on multi-objective optimization are studied and solved. Various multi-objective optimization algorithms, such as the multi-objective ant lion optimization (MOALO), the multi-objective multiverse optimization (MOMVO), the multi-objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO), the multi-objective thermal exchange optimization (MOTEO), and the multi-objective grasshopper optimization algorithm (MOGOA), are used to reduce the cost and emissions of generation fuel. With equality and inequality restrictions, the suggested work is carried out in an IEEE 30 bus system. To determine the lowest system-wide minimization of generating cost and emission, the results of several optimization strategies are compared. In terms of lowering fuel costs and emissions, the MOGOA performs better than any other multi-objective algorithms.

articleTitle: Reliable autonomous navigation of mobile robot in unconstrained environment
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Path optimization is one of the crucial problems in unmanned ground vehicles. It is associated with various concerns such as smooth trajectory, collision free planning, less time/space complexity, etc. Rapid Exploring Random Tree (RRT) provides an effective path planning however, it introduces sharp turns leading to increased travel time. Further, the mobile robot needs to align its heading angle ($\theta$) with the trajectory angle ($\beta$) else it may collide with the obstacles. Hence in this work, Improved RRT Theta algorithm is proposed that is an amalgamation of improved RRT with modified B Spline curve technique. The heading angle is aligned with the trajectory angle for collision free navigation of mobile robot and a modified B Spline method adds the new control points in the trajectory to reduce the number of sharp turns. The proposed technique is tested for different simulation based environmental conditions. The results reveal that the proposed technique proves to be an efficient path planning technique with collision free smooth movement, reduced time lag and path length as compared to the conventional RRT technique. The proposed technique may be quite helpful in autonomous navigation, trajectory tracking, path planning etc.

articleTitle: Metamaterial Inspired Dual band MIMO antenna with Open-Ended Slot and Neutralized Line for Isolation Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: This works represents the metamaterial-inspired antenna with an Open-ended slot and NL in the ground. The metamaterial unit cell is responsible for the dual-band which is based on the negative permeability of the unit cell. The openended slot of the ground eliminates the coupling at 5.62 GHz to 5.92 GHz and the neutralization line in the ground effectively null the coupling and improve the isolation (|S12|) up to 11 dB for 3.82 GHz to 4 GHz. The two-port antenna size is 30 x 35 x 0.8 mm<sup>3</sup> and accepted ECC and CCL validate the 5G and ISM applications.

articleTitle: Novel Method for Detection of Alzheimer’s Disease using Gini Impurity based Decision Tree Model
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Computer aided diagnosis (CAD) tool has received reasonable attention of the researchers over the last few decades in identifying the occurrence and/or progression of several diseases. In this paper, machine learning based one such tool has been employed for possible classification of Alzheimer’s disease. Relevant features of brain parameters have been extracted and subsequently a decision tree is formed to classify the data points. Proposed algorithm is designed and validated on a good number of training and testing data. Experimental results have shown to have a classification accuracy of 95%, sensitivity of 96.7% and specmcity of 93.3%.

articleTitle: Indian Sign Language Interpretation using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Sign language is the most common means of communication among the speech- and hearing-impaired. Just like all other languages, tools are being developed for interlanguage translation from sign language to text; however, the complexity of the sign language makes it difficult to create a computer vision model. The focus of this study is to tackle the problem with a vision-based approach using deep learning. In this work, an 8-layer Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) aimed at sign language recognition has been proposed. The model extracts feature from input images using convolutional filters before passing them to dense layers. A validation accuracy of 99.34% has been achieved on a self-created dataset comprising of 52 classes. The model has also been tested on a publicly available dataset to evaluate its efficacy.

articleTitle: Approaches towards Fake News Detection using Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Signal Processing and Integrated Networks (SPIN)
abstract: Fake news evolving around us for a very long time. The gradual growth of social media platforms has provided us with an easily accessible and publishable news platform in front of the audience that news may be true or False. The spreading of fake news increased as compared to ancient times. Nowadays Fake news detection become a tough challenge for Both Natural language processing(NLP) and Machine Learning (ML) experts. For detecting fake news fact-checking is also very important. In this paper, we focus on the analysis of recently published papers in this domain and the analysis of different techniques for detecting fake news. Through this survey, we will get inside knowledge of the detection process of fake news using different natural language processing, machine learning, and Deep Learning Techniques.
